**Preserve OpenAI Chat finish reasons in the streaming mapper.** An OpenAI Chat stream translated to an OpenAI Chat target can pass `length`, `tool_calls`, `content_filter`, or `function_call` to this mapper. The default converts them to `stop`. This violates the buffered OpenAI Chat contract and loses truncation, tool-call, and moderation signals. Preserve the OpenAI values, map `function_call` to `tool_calls`, and keep `stop` as the fallback for unknown provider reasons.
Suggested fix
```diff --- "a/crates/switchyard-translation/src/codecs/openai_chat/stream.rs" +++ "b/crates/switchyard-translation/src/codecs/openai_chat/stream.rs" @@ -437,10 +437,12 @@ // Maps provider stop reasons into OpenAI's finish-reason vocabulary. fn openai_finish_reason(reason: Option<&str>) -> String { match reason { Some("max_tokens") => "length".to_string(), Some("tool_use") => "tool_calls".to_string(), Some("refusal") => "content_filter".to_string(), + Some(reason @ ("length" | "content_filter")) => reason.to_string(), + Some("tool_calls" | "function_call") => "tool_calls".to_string(), // Reasons with no OpenAI equivalent (e.g. `pause_turn`, // `model_context_window_exceeded`) must not leak into `finish_reason`; // the buffered encoder reports them as `stop` too. _ => "stop".to_string(), ```
Committable suggestion
> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion Some("max_tokens") => "length".to_string(), Some("tool_use") => "tool_calls".to_string(), Some("refusal") => "content_filter".to_string(), Some(reason @ ("length" | "content_filter")) => reason.to_string(), Some("tool_calls" | "function_call") => "tool_calls".to_string(), // Reasons with no OpenAI equivalent (e.g. `pause_turn`, // `model_context_window_exceeded`) must not leak into `finish_reason`; // the buffered encoder reports them as `stop` too. _ => "stop".to_string(), } } ```
